name: Gozen Reiji
source:
Real name: 御前 令二 Misaki Reiji
Likes: cola, curry rice, persimmon seeds
Skill: miscellaneous chores
Role: part-time director

His real name is Misaki Reiji but [url=/c62009]Owari[/url] gave him pseudonym Gozen Reiji (meaning "midnight"). A college student who participates in game development as a part-timer. He is exceedingly ordinary and possesses both common sense and social skills, which makes him a special presence within Judgement 7.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/reiji.html]the official site[/url]]
